answer_1.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success across various natural language processing tasks, including dialogue generation, machine translation, question answering, and text summarization...our ultimate goal is to train a classifier that not only performs classification tasks but also generates analytical content to elucidate its decision-making process.
answer_1.outputs: Classification decisions with explanatory natural language content

answer_2.quote: Following, we use accuracy as the primary metric to evaluate node classification performance.

answer_3.quote: Superior LLM acts as a judge to evaluate these responses...based on three criteria: correctness of the response, adherence to instructions, and reasonableness of the explanation...we task GPT-4 with performing pairwise evaluations to select the better response

answer_4.quote: we conducted a human evaluation...designed a questionnaire involving 20 human participants...Participants were asked to select the response they deemed more interpretable based on three key criteria: coherency, logical consistency, and factuality
